title: 1.4 Composition of Functions
objectives: Create a new function by composition of functions.
Find the domain of a composite function.
Decompose a composite function into its component functions.
headings: Create a Function by Composition of Functions
Finding the Domain of a Composite Function
Decomposing a Composite Function into its Component Functions

items.title: Example 1

items.title: Example 4
